name: bookhaven
description: A production-oriented full-stack bookstore built with Next.js, React, Express, TypeScript, MongoDB, and Zod.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.audit:prod: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high --prefix backend && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high --prefix frontend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run audit:prod && npm run build
scripts.build:free: npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm test --prefix backend && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend

author: Abdulrahman Hajar
